checks.name: line: u = (x_P - s)/D and omega constant, against exact projection (<= 1e-12)
control: a path line turned 1 deg breaks it (median >= 1e-3)
arc: the point is in slit beta at theta = phi_P - delta(beta, rho), with v = dz cos(beta)/(rho sin(delta)), against exact projection (<= 1e-11)
control: a radius 2 % wrong misplaces every point (min slit error >= 1e-5 rad)
same orbit, same trace shifted in time: line (along f) and arc (about the turn axis), exact projection (<= 1e-12)
control: the moved point 5 % farther from the path line or the turn axis (median >= 1e-4)
blind sets: path line and turn axis keep their head direction (<= 1e-12)
control: 1 cm off either does not (>= 1e-5)
pivot: rotation about the eye moves every direction by the rotation alone (<= 1e-12)
control: a pivot 5 cm behind the eye adds depth-dependent motion (>= 1e-4)
line with gaze along it: -ln(u(s+t)/u(s)) is M4's d_k(zeta) (<= 1e-12)
control: the head 1 deg off the path line breaks it (median >= 1e-4)
composition: pieces join continuously in position and heading (<= 1e-12)
control: an arc 1 % short leaves a gap (>= 1e-3)
